title: Restart sensor and preemptive restarts option no longer works with new transmitter SN 81xxxx
symptom: With a new transmitter whose serial number starts with 81xxxx, preemptive sensor restart stops working; xDrip reports errors like 'Sensor Failed Start', 'Sensor marked FAILED', and 'Session Start Failed: Invalid'. The only workaround is to start the sensor using the Dexcom receiver and wait through the full two-hour warm-up. Other users with 81xxxx transmitters report that preemptive restart says 'not capable' or fails.
cause: Dexcom has restricted restart functionality in newer G6 transmitters. According to the maintainer, xDrip can currently only hard reset and perform preemptive restarts on G6 transmitters with firmware version 1.6.5.25, which includes all 80XXXX and some 81XXXX transmitters; transmitters with newer firmware (e.g., 1.6.5.27) cannot be restarted this way.
fix: No xDrip-side fix. The maintainer states that only G6 transmitters with firmware 1.6.5.25 (all 80XXXX and some 81XXXX) support hard reset/preemptive restart, and restarting other G6 transmitters requires temporarily removing the transmitter. A reported workaround is to start the sensor through the Dexcom receiver and wait through the warm-up period.
evidence_quote: We currently can only hard reset, and perform preemptive restarts on, G6 if the firmware version is 1.6.5.25. This includes all 80XXXX and some 81XXXX transmitters.
